text: Completed cross-platform linalg solver backend epic. Formal plan and AGENTS/module docs are codified; linalg owns portable solver contracts/results/reference implementations including SPD inverse; connectivity duplicate eigensolver is removed; multivar uses linalg generic solver traits with domain error mapping; optional JVM linalg-breeze adapter is implemented; backend differential tests cover Breeze vs portable eigen, SVD, generalized eigen, Cholesky/SPD inverse, QR-equivalent least squares, and failure boundaries. Verified with linalgJVM/test, linalgJS/test, linalgBreezeJVM/test, multivarJVM/test, multivarJS/test, connectivityJVM/test, connectivityJS/test, hrfJVM/test, and git diff --check.
